label: Divona system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Divona locus represented by a VCA0374 profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Divona branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VCA0374 genes, VCA0374 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Divona locus, unresolved Divona trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
